name: M5 Concurrency and limits
intro: Worker caps and the queue, concurrent jobs and repositories, conflicts and outside commits, leaders on demand, allowance, provider failures, lost sign-in and holds, job pause, resume and cancel, the no-CI declaration and the 15-minute wait, the failed-validation limit and the disk floor. One question comes from a conflict between S5's checklist and the end-of-milestone rule. When you accept it I commit it and start M6 Recovery.
notes: The demo path completes S7 with pause, resume and cancel, as decided on the 00 board.
C28 is replayed from recorded payloads, because an allowance cannot be used up on purpose without spending your own usage (AssemblyAI#12); the replay mechanism arrives here.
Leaders already start when work arrives from M1 (decided on the M1 board); M5 adds stopping idle leaders and a leader's provider choice at its start.
The side-effect-free declaration and automatic retries are in M6, with recovery, because they replace reconciliation for work that may be retried.
